title: Ghostty 1.4
why_read: A major release of a popular, actively developed terminal emulator written in Zig, of practical interest to many engineers who use terminals daily.
analysis: Ghostty is a fast, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator built by Mitchell Hashimoto that has gained a large following for its performance and native platform integration. Version 1.4 is a routine but closely watched release, and HN threads on these updates usually discuss feature additions, platform quirks, and comparisons to alternatives like Alacritty or Kitty. It's a solid but not groundbreaking update to a tool many developers already use.
